{"consolidated_memory":"storage/blob/uploader.rs: Partial upload failures—two separate incidents

**OCCASION 1 [2026-03-29]**
- File: storage/blob/uploader.rs (storage side)
- Problem: partial upload in uploader; final part never gets acknowledged
- Repro: upload 40 MB fixture over throttled link, triggered after client retried once
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query (PR #4039, branch fix/partial-upload-1)
- Measured outcome: 10 duplicate rows a day stopped being written
- Stack: Rust; covering check is module test block in storage/blob/uploader.rs

**OCCASION 2 [2026-06-19]**
- File: storage/blob/uploader.rs (storage side)
- Problem: partial upload in uploader; final part never gets acknowledged
- Repro: upload 40 MB fixture over throttled link, triggered only when input list came in empty
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest (PR #4245, branch fix/partial-upload-3)
- Measured outcome: flaky test improved from 8 failures per hundred runs to zero
- Stack: Rust; covering check is module test block in storage/blob/uploader.rs"}
